_help: Details shown when a player taps a gym badge or Elite Four member on their dashboard.
discord: the leader's Discord username, without the @.

discordId: the leader's numeric Discord user ID, so the Send challenge button can open their profile. Get it in Discord: User Settings > Advanced > turn on Developer Mode, then right-click (or long-press) the person > Copy User ID.
rules (gym leaders): special rules, as a list of lines. Use [] for none.
deckName and decklistUrl (Elite Four): the deck's name and a link to the full decklist.
Leave any value as "" until it's known. Names and badge colors live in js/config.js.
